verses.1: Remember what Jehovah has done for us. He has shown us our suffering and humiliation.
verses.2: Our land has become foreign to us, and it’s now a land of foreigners among us.
verses.3: In those days, we were alone, and our parents were not there to take care of us, just like animals.
verses.4: From our beginnings, in gold and silver, we were created at a high price.
verses.5: We were chased upon our backs; we suffered greatly, and we were not given any rest.
verses.6: From Egypt, they gave Ashur’s hands to be used for the destruction of the people.
verses.7: Our fathers sinned, and they do not repent. We are their descendants; we must bear their sins.
verses.8: Servants who have been created by our hands, they are not of our own making.
verses.9: In our hearts, we shall send forth our warriors against the destruction of the Mediterranean.
verses.10: We were like lamps that were blown out by the flames of hunger.
verses.11: The women in Zion suffered in distress in the cities of Judah.
verses.12: Their hands were used to hang the faces of the old people up; they were not freed from their suffering.
verses.13: In the branches, women carried things, and boys played around in the trees.
verses.14: The elders from Shabbat’s garden returned to their homes, with their voices filled with joy.
verses.15: It has returned to our hearts as a source of sorrow and pain.
verses.16: Our heads have fallen down, oh no! Please save us, for we have sinned.
verses.17: For this reason, David became our guide; it was through him that our eyes were enlightened.
verses.18: On Mount Zion, where the clouds gathered, they went there.
verses.19: You, Jehovah, will always sit on your throne, generation after generation.
verses.20: Why do you forget us forever? Why do you abandon us for all eternity?
verses.21: May the LORD bring us back to you. May our days be renewed, just as they were before.
verses.22: For if Masas has been angry with us, he will surely be angry with us again.
